Linux microblog update:

I am a hardcore software freedom enthusiast, and I do my best to rarely run anything but the crunchiest whole food ethically sourced community packages.

But, I also love compensating game developers.

And I'm not above running a little propriety server software (as a treat) when there's a good time to be had with friends.

Today, I particularly appreciate the Steam server ecosystem on Ubuntu.

#selfhosted #gaming #ubuntu #linux
